title: Luoyang Civic Register / Qing Lantern
summary: Civic record confirming the former operation of Qing Lantern Orphanage in Luoyang.
body:
CIVIC REGISTER

QING LANTERN ORPHANAGE

The Qing Lantern Orphanage was registered as a residential children's institution in Luoyang, Monument.

The institution operated for several decades before its records were transferred to municipal storage. Later administrative records contain references to private apprenticeship and security-service placements involving former residents.

This entry does not assess those placements.

ARCHIVE NOTE

A restricted Brightside institutional record is held under ARC-326-0426.
